issues.description: The exercise text contradicts the UML diagram for `Lecture.addGuestStudents(...)`: in Part 2.7 it asks for `addGuestStudents(String)`, while the UML specifies `addGuestStudents(int): void` and the reference solution implements `addGuestStudents(int)`. This can lead students to implement a non-matching method signature and fail tests/compilation.
issues.suggestedFix: Change Part 2.7 in problem_statement.md to require `addGuestStudents(int)` (and keep wording consistent with the UML: `addGuestStudents(int): void`). If `String` input was intended, then update the UML and solution accordingly and specify parsing/validation rules.
